# Option A — Import Manifest v0.1

**Date**: 2026-04-03
**Phase**: A3 — JSON Import & Validation

---

## 1. Import Source

**File**: `apps/api/data/dev-store-state.json`
**Format**: DevStoreSnapshot JSON (single flat file, all mutable state)
**Generated by**: `DevStorePersistence.save()` on every write operation

---

## 2. Import Order

| Layer | # | JSON Key | PG Table | Conflict Strategy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Static | 1 | (hardcoded) | users | ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING |
| Static | 2 | (seed) | word_books | Skip (already seeded) |
| Static | 3 | (seed) | words | Skip (already seeded) |
| Static | 4 | (seed) | user_book_settings | Skip (already seeded) |
| Static | 5 | (seed) | shop_catalog_items | Skip (already seeded) |
| Main | 6 | studyAttempts | study_attempts | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 7 | reviewGroups | review_groups | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 8 | reviewGroups[].items | review_group_items | ON CONFLICT (group, word) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 9 | reviewAttempts | review_attempts | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 10 | todayStates | daily_goal_progress | ON CONFLICT (user, date) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 11 | sessions | session_records | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 12 | checkIns | check_in_records | ON CONFLICT (user, date) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 13 | learningDays | learning_day_facts | ON CONFLICT (user, date) DO NOTHING |
| Main | 14 | streakRecord | streak_records | ON CONFLICT (user) DO UPDATE |
| Reward | 15 | sourceEvents | reward_source_events | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Reward | 16 | rewardLedgerItems | reward_ledger | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Reward | 17 | settlements | settlements | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Cross | 18 | idempotencyKeys | idempotency_keys | ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING |
| Second | 19 | coinsSpent + feedAccum | secondary_wallets | UPDATE existing row |
| Second | 20 | feedRecords | feed_events | ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING |
| Second | 21 | ownedItems | inventory_items | ON CONFLICT (user, item) DO NOTHING |
| Second | 22 | equippedOutfit/Room | equipment_slots | ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE |
| Second | 23 | (derived) | purchase_records | Skip (reconstructable) |

---

## 3. Validation Method

| Check | Method |
|---|---|
| Row counts | Compare JSON array length vs PG COUNT(*) for each domain |
| Coins balance | Sum reward_ledger(coins) - secondary_wallets.coins_spent in both sources |
| Fish treats balance | Sum reward_ledger(fish_treats) - SUM(feed_events.consumed_amount) |
| Pet state accumulators | Compare feedMoodAccumulated, feedExpAccumulated, feedBondAccumulated |
| Equipment | Compare equipped slot counts |
| Streak | Compare current_streak values |
| Idempotency keys | Count comparison |

---

## 4. Rollback Trigger Conditions

- Any FAIL in balance parity checks
- Any FAIL in idempotency key count (could cause duplicate writes)
- Any structural corruption (rows present in PG that contradict JSON truth)

---

## 5. Rollback Procedure

```bash
npm run db:reset    # Rolls back migration, re-migrates, re-seeds static data
```

This returns PG to clean seed state. JSON snapshot is NOT modified by import.
